description: This file contains serialization and deserialization functions for various JavaScript data types, including handling of references, errors, typed arrays, and complex objects, used within the Playwright protocol implementation.

methods.name: parseSerializedValue
methods.description: Deserializes a SerializedValue into a JavaScript value, handling references, primitives, errors, typed arrays, arrays, objects, and handles.

methods.name: serializeValue
methods.description: Serializes a JavaScript value into a SerializedValue, handling primitives, errors, typed arrays, arrays, objects, and references.
